## 問題
2025 年 3 月新註冊的客戶有幾位？

## 回答 A
最終答案: 150
採用的定義與依據: 以 customers.signup_date 作為註冊日期（語意層無「新註冊」定義，改以欄位結構判定），篩選 2025-03-01 至 2025-03-31 的客戶，共 150 位，customer_id 無重複。
SQL 1: SELECT substr(signup_date,1,7) AS ym, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(signup_date) AS min_raw, MAX(signup_date) AS max_raw FROM customers WHERE signup_date LIKE '2025-03%' OR signup_date LIKE '2025/03%' OR signup_date LIKE '2025%03%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SQL 2: SELECT length(signup_date) AS len, substr(signup_date,1,4) AS yr, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS dist_cust, COUNT(DISTINCT email) AS dist_email, MIN(signup_date) AS min_raw, MAX(signup_date) AS max_raw FROM customers GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1
  結果: {'columns': ['len', 'yr', 'n', 'dist_cust', 'dist_email', 'min_raw', 'max_raw'], 'rows': [[10, '2023', 1659, 1659, 1659, '2023-01-01', '2023-12-31'], [10, '2024', 1708, 1708, 1708, '2024-01-01', '2024-12-31'], [10, '2025', 1633, 1633, 1633, '2025-01-01', '2025-12-31']], 'truncated': False}
SQL 3: ["SELECT COUNT(*) AS march_signups, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customers FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2025-03-01' AND signup_date < '2025-04-01'", "SELECT signup_date, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2025-03-01' AND signup_date < '2025-04-01' GROUP BY signup_date ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10"]

## 回答 B
最終答案: 150
採用的定義與依據: 語意層無「新註冊客戶」「註冊日期」的對應，改以 customers.signup_date 作為註冊日期，篩選 2025-03-01 至 2025-03-31 並計算不重複 customer_id，結果為 150 位。已檢查 signup_date 全部為 ISO 格式且無空值，且筆數與不重複客戶數一致（皆為 150）。
SQL 1: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS new_customers, MIN(signup_date) AS min_signup, MAX(signup_date) AS max_signup, COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2025-03-01' AND signup_date < '2025-04-01'
  結果: {'columns': ['new_customers', 'min_signup', 'max_signup', 'total_rows'], 'rows': [[150, '2025-03-01', '2025-03-31', 150]], 'truncated': False}
SQL 2: SELECT COUNT(*) AS non_iso_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE signup_date LIKE '2025-03-%') AS march_iso_rows FROM customers WHERE signup_date NOT GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' OR signup_date IS NULL
  結果: {'columns': ['non_iso_rows', 'march_iso_rows'], 'rows': [[0, 0]], 'truncated': False}

response: {"winner": "tie", "reason": "兩者都以 customers.signup_date 篩選 2025-03-01 至 2025-03-31，得到相同答案 150，也都做了日期格式與不重複客戶數的檢查（A 依長度與年份分組，B 檢查非 ISO 格式與空值），驗證強度相當，沒有實質差異。", "critical_error": false}
